name: How should I prepare my home before a room renovation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before a room renovation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before work starts, clear out all personal belongings, furniture, wall decor, and window treatments to protect your property and provide clear workspace. Ensure pets and children have designated areas away from the construction zone. It also helps to decide on finish selections early, such as paint sheens, trim profiles, and tile patterns, so materials are secured before installation. HH Remodeling protects surrounding rooms from construction dust during drywall patching and carpentry, but having pathways cleared speeds up preparation significantly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out all furniture, decor, and personal belongings from the space, establish a clear path for workers, and finalize your tile, trim, and paint selections early.
